note: TacJS Media is a submodule of TacJS providing a single consent-aware oEmbed field formatter, plugin id 'tacjs_oembed' (label 'oEmbed content (TacJS integration)'), class TacJSOEmbedFormatter extends core OEmbedFormatter, for field types link/string/string_long. It converts the iframe to a div with a provider class (youtube_player/vimeo_player/dailymotion_player) and a videoID attribute and drops src, so tarteaucitron only loads the player after consent. No config form; the choice is stored in the entity_view_display config as the field component 'type: tacjs_oembed'. Requires tacjs + core media. Medium/hard cases create a namespaced link field on Article and are grounded in the real view-display formatter config.

evals.prompt: The TacJS Media submodule adds a field formatter for embedding remote video behind cookie consent. What is the formatter's plugin id and label?
evals.expected_output: The formatter plugin id is tacjs_oembed, labelled 'oEmbed content (TacJS integration)'. It extends core's OEmbedFormatter.

evals.prompt: What does the TacJS Media oEmbed formatter change about how a YouTube or Vimeo video is rendered, compared to core's oEmbed formatter?
evals.expected_output: Instead of a ready-to-play iframe it renders a div with a provider class (youtube_player/vimeo_player/dailymotion_player) and a videoID attribute, dropping the src, so tarteaucitron.js only builds the player after the visitor consents to that service.

evals.prompt: How do I make a remote-video field use TacJS Media so the video only loads after consent, and which field types does the formatter support?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage display, choose the 'oEmbed content (TacJS integration)' formatter (tacjs_oembed); it supports link, string and string_long field types. Also enable the matching TacJS service (youtube/vimeo/dailymotion).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one field on the Article content type is displayed with the TacJS-integrated oEmbed formatter. Inspect the live default view display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_tjm_known: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component has type: tacjs_oembed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a link field field_tjm_task that holds a video URL. Configure its default display so it is rendered with the TacJS Media consent-aware oEmbed formatter. Apply the change to the live view display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_tjm_task component's formatter type to tacjs_oembed (via Manage display -> Format 'oEmbed content (TacJS integration)', or setComponent with type=tacjs_oembed and save).
